selection.condition: rcx = (r12 bit 14) | (vendor != "GenuineIntel" compare residue) is nonzero
selection.a_rule: A = r12 if the condition holds, else r12 & 0xf9ffffffffffbfff
selection.b_rule: B = r15 if the condition holds, else zero-extended low 32 bits of r15

suffix.equations: C0 = A | H; C1 = ((B << 1) | (A >> 63)) | H; C2 = (B >> 62) | H; raw rax return = A (merged RE-002 cache-publication packet)

early_paths.max_leaf_zero: 0x5caddf3 jumps to the suffix with A = 0 and B = 0; the leaf is never called
early_paths.region_gate: unless cpuid leaf 1 ecx bits 26,27 are both set, 0x5cae042 jumps to 0x5cae251 and then to the selection at 0x5cae35e; the leaf is never called and none of the xcr0 terms executes

limits: XCR0 composition of the refresh helper only: the value-flow taint verdict, the three post-call reads of the leaf result, the four XCR0 control gates and the cache fields they drive, the A/B selection at 0x5cae35e and the suffix store sites. The publication equations themselves are the merged RE-002 cache-publication packet's and are cited, not re-derived; the leaf result rule is the RE-002 xcr0-leaf packet's. The field-by-field CPUID attribution of the always-on early compositions of R12 and R15 outside the XCR0-gated regions, feature/ISA names for any bit, runtime XCR0/CPUID values, and any gate are not claimed. Taint tracks value flow only: flag-mediated selection (test, sete, cmov) propagates the taint of the selected values, never of the condition. No captured code executed.

value_taint.method: forward may-taint over decoded blocks; taint enters only as the leaf call result in rax and the conservative caller-saved set; cpuid outputs and immediates are untainted; flag-mediated selection propagates selected values only
